references.text: The same command to keep the Lord's statutes and laws, with a promise of life for those who follow them.
An identical command to keep all the Lord's statutes and laws and do according to them.
The preceding verse which also deals with sanctification and keeping oneself holy before the Lord.
The Lord declares Himself as the one who sanctifies His people, using the same expression 'אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם'.
A repeated command to keep the commandments, with the Lord's declaration that He sanctifies Israel.
The Lord identifies Himself as the one who sanctifies Israel, reflecting the same theological concept.
Ezekiel prophesies that the nations will know that the Lord sanctifies Israel.
Moses exhorts the people to keep the Lord's laws and commandments.
A command to keep and do according to the commandments, statutes, and laws.
Paul prays that the God of peace Himself may sanctify the believers completely and wholeheartedly.
Jesus who sanctifies and those who are sanctified all have the same origin.
